verdict.reason: The source says Canary Media counted 720 Megapacks in satellite imagery, but the developer did give a figure (Trettel said 3.3 GWh at the TVA board) and McGowan gave another (2,000 MW). Only the utility's comms team and TVA declined to clarify and SpaceXAI didn't respond, so the claim that all three "wouldn't say" misstates the context.
